name: Beast Muisek
summary: In Feralas, the Beast Muisek Vessel can shrink a fallen beast and hold its muisek. The captured essence is needed to test the vessel.

sections.title: A Captured Essence
sections.body: Among Feralas’s beasts, Ironfur Bears and Longtooth Runners can be captured with the Beast Muisek Vessel. When one falls, the vessel shrinks it and holds its muisek before the spirit can escape. The captured muisek is the measure of the vessel’s power.

faq.answer: Beast Muisek is the essence captured from a fallen beast with the Beast Muisek Vessel.

faq.q: How do you get Beast Muisek?
faq.answer: Use the Beast Muisek Vessel on a fallen Ironfur Bear or Longtooth Runner in Feralas.
Beast Muisek is needed to test the Beast Muisek Vessel.

faq.q: Why capture a beast after it dies?
faq.answer: A creature’s muisek may escape after a violent death. The vessel shrinks the fallen beast and captures its muisek before it can flee.
